source.name: Inter Miami CF – 'South Florida Proud: Royal Caribbean Takes Center Stage on Inter Miami CF's Iconic Jerseys'
source.quote: the world's largest cruise line will make its mark front and center on every Inter Miami jersey as the Official Jersey Partner, beginning with upcoming 2024 campaign

note: Multiyear front-of-jersey deal beginning with the 2024 season; no reported value. Sportcal described Royal Caribbean's front deal as an eight-figure annual deal, the most lucrative in MLS history when signed in 2024 (no exact figure published).
